'''Mengxuan Vale''' is an area of [[Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou]], [[Huanglong]]. It can be found in the [[Heart of Stillness]].

==Description==
Mengxuan Vale is a village that is home to the [[Celestials]] who live in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. Centered in the region between the [[Heart of Flames]], [[Heart of Frost]], [[Heart of Bloom]], and [[Heart of Ruin]], it is a bustling village populated by Celestials and lingering remnant frequencies of [[Mengzhou]]'s populace formed from [[Hsin]]'s memories. 

The village also brims with Autopuppet units throughout. A towering astrolabe-like Celestial mechanism floats at the center, overlooking a portal to Hsin's Heart Realm recreation of Mengzhou's capital.
